Juuza Engi - Engetsu Sangokuden.name: Juuzaengi: Engetsu Sangokuden
Juuza Engi - Engetsu Sangokuden.summary: Juuzaengi: Engetsu Sangokuden is an otome game, developed by RED Entertainment and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2012.

Shinobido - Tales of the Ninja.name: Shinobido: Tales of the Ninja
Shinobido - Tales of the Ninja.summary: Shinobido: Tales of the Ninja is a sequel to Shinobido: Way of the Ninja. A North American version was to be released as Shinobido Homura: Soul of the Ninja but was cancelled. The game was followed by Shinobido 2: Tales of the Ninja.
